title: begin runs a land_push whose program is a .py file directly, so the kb's own land_push fails with Permission denied
goal: begin sends the claim commits with the land_push argument list the way land does: a first element ending in .py runs under python3, so the kb's land_push [_tools/kbgit.py, sync, --push] runs and begin goes on to dispatch

run:
import sys,tempfile,pathlib as P,types
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import bl_dispatch as d
r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());(r/"t.py").write_text("import pathlib;pathlib.Path(\"ran\").write_text(\"x\")")
d.setting=lambda k:["t.py"] if k=="land_push" else []
d.begin_push(types.SimpleNamespace(root=r))
sys.exit(0 if (r/"ran").exists() else 1)

notes: Found 2026-10-25 by the SP-f7kaebel runner: begin ST-ekb5b7ic claimed, then raised PermissionError on _tools/kbgit.py (traceback from bl_dispatch.begin_push). bl_land.land_push names the program by its basename and land_run(program=True) runs it; begin_push passes argv to subprocess.run unchanged. The claim was pushed and dispatched by hand. Belongs to the begin story of SP-vxdacfpl (ST-44md64ps, landed). Taken into SP-vxdacfpl 2026-10-25 at the manager's request: it breaks the begin story's goal clause (claim pushed through land_push) on this repo's own land_push.
